notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 24 part 1 (Internet Archive buildingengineer244cont), the 26 weekly issues from 5 January to 28 June 1924. Same method as the later volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1923-1926, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1924. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 218 of the 368 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out (where the crop shows only the heading, only the heading is published). Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note; scrub_owner.py removes the fragments the OCR garbles past the first cut); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor, architect or engineer named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates are set from the dated running heads, 26 issues one week apart with no gap. Permits whose heading counts more than one dwelling (46) were set aside before the image check and sit with the held single houses, as do eleven single houses that were read against the image and had no name left to publish once the owner-builder was cut.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 24 to 31 read (January 1924 to January 1932); the 18 half-year volumes before 1924 (1915 to December 1923) are unread, vol. 23 part 2 (July-December 1923, buildingengineer2193cont) next. In this volume: 523 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, single houses with no architect named and no page (46 of them permits for a row of houses), are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; all but eleven still need the image check). 599 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 1,034 rows were not placed: location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), street pairs that do not cross under the names read, and printed street numbers with no EAS row today.
coverage.note: 4,505 numbered entries read, 2,513 San Francisco rows, 1,479 placed on a parcel, 368 picked and read against the page image, 306 published on 288 pages (195 seeded), 50 held back: thirty-eight uses, storeys or unit counts that contradict the roll, four same-issue contracts, three repeat listings, and five others (an Oakland address, a lot that is a whole block, a roll date two years off, and two alterations that could not be tied to the building); eleven more joined the held houses and one parcel has no address row.
